label: president or manager office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or public body Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the previous president-plus-manager scope. President and manager descriptions, including historical service, qualify. Executive, chair, director, coach, generic leadership, employment and ownership alone do not.

facts.reason: Ernie Grunfeld is explicitly Knicks president and manager; coach, player and director rows add different roles.
A reign at the F.B.I. suggests leadership but does not identify the specific president or manager office required by this predicate.
Bill Keller sends something to a reader regarding a Times publication. This supplied row establishes no president or manager office.
